name: specnaut-cockpit
description: A Claude Code mod: it runs a hooks module inside Claude Code with your permissions. Shows usage limits, context, cost and the Specnaut chain above the prompt, and refuses one call: the step that would start implement, review or merge past the quota threshold.

hold_at.title: Quota hold (%)
hold_at.description: The autopilot stops before implement, review or merge when a usage window is at or above this. 100 turns the hold off.

warn_at.title: Usage warning (%)
warn_at.description: A usage window at or above this is shown in the warning colour and announced once per window.

band.title: Show the band above the prompt
band.description: Turn off to keep only the /cockpit pane and the quota hold.
